blurb: Antelope Hills Golf Courses offers two 36-hole golf experiences: a traditional parkland-style North Course and a modern links-style South Course. The facility includes a full practice complex with a driving range, putting greens, and a short-game area. The Manzanita Grill serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner with a full bar and outdoor patio.
extraNote: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance · Rain checks issued if course unplayable due to weather, prorated by holes completed · Credit card not charged at booking; cancellations inside 24-hour window may be charged
